name: Fluorine-free cathode binder
problem: Battery cathodes are glued with PVDF, a PFAS made with toxic NMP solvent
design: Fluorine-free binder polymer that holds high-nickel cathodes at 4.4 V

market.what: battery-grade PVDF cathode binder plus battery NMP solvent purchases, world (China ~83% of cells)
market.method: PVDF ~90 kt (China 78.7 kt CICC + est. 12 kt ex-China) x ~$9.5k/t China, ~$18k/t ex-China = ~$0.95B; + battery NMP est. ~half of $1.1-1.2B NMP market = ~$0.5B; check: binder reports $2.1-2.7B x 45% PVDF = $0.9-1.2B

value.logic: est. if binder also runs in water: ~$1.5/kWh saved (drying + NMP recovery ~10 kWh elec/kg NMP, dryer/recovery capex, NMP make-up) x 2,280 GWh = ~$3.4B; plus no PFAS compliance risk
value.revenue_logic: yr 7: high-Ni cells est. ~1,750 GWh x 25 t/GWh = ~44 kt binder; 2% share = ~880 t x ~$18/kg
value.margin_logic: specialty polymer from toll maker; must price near ternary PVDF (~$17/kg China), so margin capped

trend.drivers: Li-ion 2,280 GWh 2025 to ~6,000 GWh 2030 (EVTank, ~21%/yr); PVDF price spikes on R142b quota (Nov 2025 up); OEM PFAS-free pull. EU push is weak: batteries get 13.5-yr fluoropolymer derogation in 2025 dossier
trend.deadline: EU SEAC final PFAS opinion end-2026; battery binder ban not before ~2040 if 13.5-yr derogation holds; Minnesota PFAS-in-products ban 2032

competition.notes: Nanoramic strongest: $44M Dec 2024 (GM Ventures, Samsung Ventures), shipping 2026; Westra (2020, Sweden) EUR 6.5M EIC + EUR 3.8M Sep 2025, 9 to 65 t/yr plant. Dry-electrode players (AM Batteries $30M Series B) still use PTFE, also a PFAS. Hansol/POSTECH aramid binder 2024

lab.synth: polymer: 1-2 step functional monomer + radical copolymerization, 3 variants x 20-50 g; university or CRO polymer lab
lab.test: NMC811 slurry (water or NMP) and coating, 180 deg peel (ASTM D903 style), coin cells 3.0-4.4 V, ~200 cycles vs PVDF control; then small pouch; university battery lab or CRO (e.g. CIDETEC)
lab.logic: synth 8-10 wk + coat/peel 2 wk + cycling 6-8 wk; synth ~$30k + electrodes/cells/cycler time ~$25k (est.; small-lab electrode+coin cell ~$75 each)

sale.gates: cell maker pouch/cylinder samples 1 yr; pilot-line coating + A/B samples 1-2 yr; first order likely ESS/consumer cells; auto C/D samples + PPAP 4-6 yr
